blocks.zh: 加快探索人工智能驱动的新型科研范式和技术研发模式，推进科学大模型研发应用，建设科研智能平台和高质量科学数据集，加强人工智能与量子科技、生命科学、新材料、新能源、6G等领域技术协同创新。
blocks.en: Accelerate the exploration of new research paradigms and technology R&D models driven by artificial intelligence, advance the R&D and application of large scientific models, build intelligent research platforms and high-quality scientific datasets, and strengthen collaborative technological innovation between artificial intelligence and fields such as quantum science and technology, life sciences, new materials, new energy and 6G.

blocks.zh: 推动人工智能在工业设计、中试、生产、运营等全环节落地应用，加快电力系统调控、能源勘探开发、新能源功率预测等场景创新。面向生物育种、生产管理、疫病防治等场景加快农业数智化升级。在软件信息、金融商务、交通物流等服务业领域，推动智能终端、智能体等广泛应用。
blocks.en: Promote the application of artificial intelligence throughout the whole process of industrial design, pilot testing, production and operation, and accelerate scenario innovation such as power system regulation, energy exploration and development, and new energy power forecasting. Accelerate the digital and intelligent upgrading of agriculture in scenarios such as biological breeding, production management and disease prevention and control. In service sectors such as software and information, finance and business, and transport and logistics, promote the wide application of intelligent terminals and intelligent agents.

blocks.zh: 开发提效型、陪伴型等智能原生应用，发展人工智能手机和电脑、智能机器人等新一代智能终端，探索智能产品新形态。拓展智能服务消费新场景，建设一批人工智能体验中心，打造一体化全场景覆盖的智能交互环境。
blocks.en: Develop efficiency-enhancing and companion-type intelligent native applications, develop new-generation intelligent terminals such as AI phones and computers and intelligent robots, and explore new forms of intelligent products. Expand new scenarios for intelligent service consumption, build a batch of artificial intelligence experience centers, and create an integrated intelligent interaction environment covering all scenarios.

blocks.zh: 创新智能学伴、智能教师等教学模式，深化精准教学、个性化学习、智能辅学等应用。推广高水平居民健康助手，扩大智能辅助诊疗在基层医疗机构的应用。推动人工智能在文化创作生产传播、旅游服务体验等领域创新应用。提升住宅设计和居住智能化水平。探索人机协同的新型工作形态，推动具身智能在劳动力紧缺、环境高危等岗位应用。
blocks.en: Innovate teaching models such as intelligent learning companions and intelligent teachers, and deepen applications such as precision teaching, personalized learning and intelligent tutoring. Promote high-level resident health assistants and expand the application of AI-assisted diagnosis and treatment in grassroots medical institutions. Promote innovative applications of artificial intelligence in cultural creation, production and dissemination, and tourism service experiences. Improve the level of intelligence in residential design and living. Explore new forms of work featuring human-machine collaboration, and promote the application of embodied intelligence in posts with labor shortages or high environmental risks.

blocks.zh: 加强人工智能在市场综合监管、安全生产监管、防灾减灾救灾、社会治安管理、网络空间维护、生态环境保护等方面应用，探索构建自然人、数字人、智能机器人等协同的安全治理体系。
blocks.en: Strengthen the application of artificial intelligence in comprehensive market regulation, work safety supervision, disaster prevention, reduction and relief, public security management, cyberspace maintenance, and ecological and environmental protection, and explore the building of a security governance system in which natural persons, digital humans and intelligent robots work in coordination.

blocks.zh: 推动成立世界人工智能合作组织，建设“一带一路”人工智能多边合作平台、国际人工智能应用合作中心，推动各国共同制定监管框架、技术标准和伦理规范。加快构建面向全球开放的开源技术体系和社区生态。
blocks.en: Promote the establishment of a world artificial intelligence cooperation organization, build a “Belt and Road” artificial intelligence multilateral cooperation platform and an international artificial intelligence application cooperation center, and promote the joint formulation of regulatory frameworks, technical standards and ethical norms by all countries. Accelerate the building of an open-source technology system and community ecosystem open to the world.
